description: Change existing hyperlinks and cross-references (Window > Interactive > Hyperlinks): rename, set the appearance, point to a new URL, page, anchor or paragraph (Hyperlink Options, Edit Hyperlink, Relink Cross-Reference), change a cross-reference's format (Cross-Reference Options), reset the source to other text, delete, go to the source or destination, update cross-references, and rename a text anchor (Hyperlink Destination Options).

appearance.description: set_appearance: the source rectangle and highlight

color.description: Rectangle colour: An InDesign UI colour name (e.g. LIGHT_BLUE, RED, GRID_GREEN) or "#RRGGBB"

visible.description: Show a visible rectangle around the source

destination.description: set_destination: one of url, pageIndex, anchor or paragraph

paragraph.description: A paragraph: the paragraph holding this text (relinks a cross-reference)

find.description: Text to find in the document (matched case-sensitively); the match is used

frameId.description: A text frame id; the text in that frame is used

length.description: With start: how many characters; 0 or absent means the point at start

occurrence.description: With find: which match to use, 1 for the first (default 1)

selection.description: Use the current text selection or text cursor

start.description: With storyId or frameId: the first character, counted from 0

storyId.description: A story id (get_document_stories lists them); its text is used

url.description: A URL (http:, https:, mailto: or ftp:)

id.description: The hyperlink id, instead of name

name.description: The hyperlink or cross-reference name (rename_destination: the text anchor's name)

source.description: reset_source: the text that becomes the hyperlink source
